name: Kurahashi Mikoto
source:
Class: Camellia, Second Year
Club Affiliation: None

One of the prettiest and most popular girls in school. She receives a lot of love letters, but dislikes how many people ask her out based on her looks alone. Cool and aloof, she prefers to be on her own, and isn’t often found hanging out with other girls. She cares deeply for her sickly younger sister, [url=/c97601]Yumi[/url], and has always felt a strong duty to protect her. However, she herself seems to rely on Yumi in some ways. She starts dating [url=/c97599]Shiori[/url] in order to keep Yumi safe, despite suspecting that Shiori is her blackmailer.
